title: A jailbroken AI agent spent two weeks inside a European telecom
short: A jailbroken AI agent spent two weeks inside a European telecom. The attacker left its 70+ session logs in an open folder. Full story: https://badeifer.github.io/news/operation-snowball-ai-agent-telecom/ #cybersecurity #AIagents #telecom #infosec
x: A jailbroken DeepSeek agent spent two weeks inside a European telecom, chose its own exploits and rewrote its tools when blocked. The attacker left the logs in an open folder. https://badeifer.github.io/news/operation-snowball-ai-agent-telecom/
linkedin:
Malbear Labs found an attacker's open folder with more than 70 session logs from a jailbroken DeepSeek agent. With a handful of short messages from its operator, it broke into a European telecom through a Cisco BroadWorks flaw and rewrote its tools each time a defence stopped it.

How much it took is not settled: the claims come from the agent's own reports. If you run BroadWorks, patch to RI.2026.07, and treat any internet-facing JBoss AS 6 as compromised. https://badeifer.github.io/news/operation-snowball-ai-agent-telecom/
